question: What do waves transfer from one place to another?
urdu_translation: waves one place سے another place تک کیا transfer کرتی ہیں؟
A: Energy without transferring matter / matter transfer کیے بغیر energy
B: Matter without energy / energy کے بغیر matter
C: Only electric charge / صرف electric charge
correct_answer: A | Energy without transferring matter / matter transfer کیے بغیر energy

question: How do particles of a medium behave as a wave passes?
urdu_translation: wave pass ہونے پر medium کے particles کیسے behave کرتے ہیں؟
A: They travel permanently with the wave / وہ permanently wave کے ساتھ travel کرتے ہیں
B: They oscillate about their original positions / وہ اپنی original positions کے around oscillate کرتے ہیں
C: They disappear / وہ disappear ہو جاتے ہیں
D: They become stationary forever / وہ ہمیشہ stationary ہو جاتے ہیں
correct_answer: B | They oscillate about their original positions / وہ اپنی original positions کے around oscillate کرتے ہیں

question: What happens to a floating twig when water ripples pass?
urdu_translation: water ripples pass ہونے پر floating twig کے ساتھ کیا ہوتا ہے؟
A: It mainly oscillates while energy moves outward / یہ mainly oscillate کرتا ہے جبکہ energy outward move کرتی ہے
B: It travels with every crest to the shore / یہ ہر crest کے ساتھ shore تک travel کرتا ہے
C: It sinks because matter is transferred / matter transfer ہونے سے sink کرتا ہے
D: It stops all wave motion / یہ تمام wave motion stop کرتا ہے
correct_answer: A | It mainly oscillates while energy moves outward / یہ mainly oscillate کرتا ہے جبکہ energy outward move کرتی ہے

question: Which apparatus is used to study water-wave motion in the chapter?
urdu_translation: chapter میں water-wave motion study کرنے کے لیے کون سا apparatus use ہوتا ہے؟
A: Gold-leaf electroscope / gold-leaf electroscope
B: Bell jar only / صرف bell jar
correct_answer: C | Ripple tank / ripple tank

question: Which waves require a material medium?
urdu_translation: کون سی waves material medium require کرتی ہیں؟
A: Electromagnetic waves / electromagnetic waves
B: Light waves only / صرف light waves
C: Gamma rays only / صرف gamma rays
correct_answer: D | Mechanical waves / mechanical waves

question: Which waves can travel through vacuum?
urdu_translation: کون سی waves vacuum سے travel کر سکتی ہیں؟
A: Electromagnetic waves / electromagnetic waves
B: Sound waves / sound waves
correct_answer: A | Electromagnetic waves / electromagnetic waves

question: What is the approximate speed of electromagnetic waves in vacuum?
urdu_translation: vacuum میں electromagnetic waves کی approximate speed کیا ہے؟
correct_answer: C | 3 × 10⁸ m/s

question: Which example is a mechanical wave?
urdu_translation: mechanical wave کی example کون سی ہے؟
A: X-ray / X-ray
B: Sound wave / sound wave
D: Visible light in vacuum / vacuum میں visible light
correct_answer: B | Sound wave / sound wave

question: In a transverse wave, particle vibration is:
urdu_translation: transverse wave میں particle vibration کی direction کیا ہوتی ہے؟
A: Parallel to wave travel / wave travel کے parallel
B: Perpendicular to wave travel / wave travel کے perpendicular
correct_answer: B | Perpendicular to wave travel / wave travel کے perpendicular

question: What is the highest point of a transverse wave called?
urdu_translation: transverse wave کا highest point کیا کہلاتا ہے؟
A: Crest / crest
B: Trough / trough
correct_answer: A | Crest / crest

question: What is the lowest point of a transverse wave called?
urdu_translation: transverse wave کا lowest point کیا کہلاتا ہے؟
A: Crest / crest
B: Compression / compression
correct_answer: D | Trough / trough

question: In a longitudinal wave, particle vibration is:
urdu_translation: longitudinal wave میں particle vibration کی direction کیا ہوتی ہے؟
A: Perpendicular to wave travel / wave travel کے perpendicular
B: Parallel to wave travel / wave travel کے parallel
correct_answer: B | Parallel to wave travel / wave travel کے parallel

question: Which regions occur in a longitudinal wave?
urdu_translation: longitudinal wave میں کون سے regions occur کرتے ہیں؟
A: Crests and troughs only / صرف crests اور troughs
B: Nodes and antinodes only / صرف nodes اور antinodes
C: Compressions and rarefactions / compressions اور rarefactions
D: Charges and fields / charges اور fields
correct_answer: C | Compressions and rarefactions / compressions اور rarefactions

question: Which wave is longitudinal?
urdu_translation: کون سی wave longitudinal ہے؟
A: Light wave / light wave
B: Wave on a rope moved up and down / up-down moved rope کی wave
D: Sound wave in air / air میں sound wave
correct_answer: D | Sound wave in air / air میں sound wave

question: What is wavelength?
urdu_translation: wavelength کیا ہے؟
A: Number of cycles per second / cycles per second کی number
B: Maximum displacement only / صرف maximum displacement
C: Distance between two consecutive corresponding points / two consecutive corresponding points کے درمیان distance
D: Time for half a cycle / half cycle کا time
correct_answer: C | Distance between two consecutive corresponding points / two consecutive corresponding points کے درمیان distance

question: What is frequency?
urdu_translation: frequency کیا ہے؟
A: Distance between two crests / two crests کے درمیان distance
B: Maximum displacement / maximum displacement
C: Speed divided by time / speed divided by time
D: Number of cycles per second / number of cycles per second
correct_answer: D | Number of cycles per second / number of cycles per second

question: What is the SI unit of frequency?
urdu_translation: frequency کی SI unit کیا ہے؟
A: m
B: s
correct_answer: C | Hz

question: What is amplitude?
urdu_translation: amplitude کیا ہے؟
A: Distance travelled in one second / one second میں travelled distance
B: Number of cycles in one metre / one metre میں cycles کی number
C: Maximum displacement from equilibrium / equilibrium سے maximum displacement
D: Total wave mass / total wave mass
correct_answer: C | Maximum displacement from equilibrium / equilibrium سے maximum displacement

question: Which equation relates wave speed, frequency, and wavelength?
urdu_translation: wave speed، frequency اور wavelength کو کون سی equation relate کرتی ہے؟
A: v = f/λ
B: v = fλ
correct_answer: B | v = fλ

question: A wave has f = 5 Hz and λ = 2 m. What is its speed?
urdu_translation: درج ذیل wave کی speed معلوم کریں: f = 5 Hz, λ = 2 m
B: 7 m/s
correct_answer: D | 10 m/s

question: A wave travels at 300 m/s and has λ = 3 m. What is its frequency?
urdu_translation: درج ذیل wave کی frequency معلوم کریں: v = 300 m/s, λ = 3 m
A: 900 Hz
B: 100 Hz
correct_answer: B | 100 Hz

question: A wave has frequency 50 Hz. What is its time period?
urdu_translation: درج ذیل wave کا time period معلوم کریں: f = 50 Hz
B: 2 s

question: What is reflection of waves?
urdu_translation: reflection of waves کیا ہے؟
A: Changing medium and speed / medium اور speed change کرنا
B: Bouncing back into the same medium / same medium میں واپس bounce ہونا
C: Spreading through a slit / slit سے spread ہونا
D: Changing frequency only / صرف frequency change ہونا
correct_answer: B | Bouncing back into the same medium / same medium میں واپس bounce ہونا

question: According to the law of reflection:
urdu_translation: law of reflection کے مطابق کیا relation ہے؟
A: Angle of incidence equals angle of reflection / angle of incidence، angle of reflection کے equal ہے
B: Angle of incidence is double the reflection angle / angle of incidence reflection angle کا double ہے
C: Frequency becomes zero / frequency zero ہو جاتی ہے
D: Wavelength always doubles / wavelength ہمیشہ double ہوتی ہے
correct_answer: A | Angle of incidence equals angle of reflection / angle of incidence، angle of reflection کے equal ہے

question: What is refraction of waves?
urdu_translation: refraction of waves کیا ہے؟
A: Bouncing back into the same medium / same medium میں bounce back
B: Complete absorption / complete absorption
C: Change of direction caused by change of speed between regions or media / regions یا media کے درمیان speed change سے direction change
correct_answer: C | Change of direction caused by change of speed between regions or media / regions یا media کے درمیان speed change سے direction change

question: What remains constant when water waves refract from deep to shallow water?
urdu_translation: deep سے shallow water میں water waves refract ہونے پر کیا constant رہتا ہے؟
A: Speed / speed
B: Wavelength / wavelength
correct_answer: D | Frequency / frequency

question: What happens to water waves entering shallow water from deep water?
urdu_translation: deep water سے shallow water میں enter ہونے والی waves کے ساتھ کیا ہوتا ہے؟
A: They speed up and wavelength increases / وہ speed up ہوتی ہیں اور wavelength increase ہوتی ہے
B: They slow down, shorten in wavelength, and may bend / وہ slow ہوتی ہیں، wavelength short ہوتی ہے اور bend کر سکتی ہیں
C: Frequency becomes zero / frequency zero ہو جاتی ہے
D: They stop transferring energy / وہ energy transfer stop کرتی ہیں
correct_answer: B | They slow down, shorten in wavelength, and may bend / وہ slow ہوتی ہیں، wavelength short ہوتی ہے اور bend کر سکتی ہیں

question: What is diffraction?
urdu_translation: diffraction کیا ہے؟
A: Bending and spreading around obstacles or through openings / obstacles کے around یا openings سے bending اور spreading
B: Reflection from a smooth surface / smooth surface سے reflection
C: Change from mechanical to electromagnetic wave / mechanical سے electromagnetic wave change
D: Loss of all wave energy / تمام wave energy کا loss
correct_answer: A | Bending and spreading around obstacles or through openings / obstacles کے around یا openings سے bending اور spreading

question: When is diffraction greatest at a slit?
urdu_translation: slit پر diffraction greatest کب ہوتی ہے؟
A: When slit size is equal to or smaller than wavelength / جب slit size wavelength کے equal یا smaller ہو
B: When slit is much wider than wavelength / جب slit wavelength سے بہت wider ہو
C: When frequency is zero / جب frequency zero ہو
D: When no wave reaches the slit / جب کوئی wave slit تک نہ پہنچے
correct_answer: A | When slit size is equal to or smaller than wavelength / جب slit size wavelength کے equal یا smaller ہو

question: Why can sound be heard around a corner?
urdu_translation: sound corner کے around کیوں hear ہو سکتی ہے؟
A: Sound travels only in straight lines / sound صرف straight lines میں travel کرتی ہے
B: Sound waves diffract around obstacles / sound waves obstacles کے around diffract کرتی ہیں
C: Sound reflects from vacuum / sound vacuum سے reflect ہوتی ہے
D: Sound becomes light / sound light بن جاتی ہے
correct_answer: B | Sound waves diffract around obstacles / sound waves obstacles کے around diffract کرتی ہیں

question: Which seismic waves are fastest and detected first?
urdu_translation: کون سی seismic waves fastest اور first detected ہوتی ہیں؟
A: Surface waves only / صرف surface waves
B: Light waves / light waves
correct_answer: C | P-waves / P-waves

question: P-waves can travel through:
urdu_translation: P-waves کن states سے travel کر سکتی ہیں؟
A: Solids only / صرف solids
B: Liquids only / صرف liquids
D: Solids, liquids, and gases / solids، liquids اور gases
correct_answer: D | Solids, liquids, and gases / solids، liquids اور gases

question: What commonly causes a tsunami?
urdu_translation: tsunami commonly کس وجہ سے cause ہوتی ہے؟
A: Ordinary sea breeze / ordinary sea breeze
B: Conduction in metal / metal میں conduction
C: Sudden underwater disturbance such as an earthquake / sudden underwater disturbance جیسے earthquake
correct_answer: C | Sudden underwater disturbance such as an earthquake / sudden underwater disturbance جیسے earthquake

question: As a tsunami approaches shallow water, what happens?
urdu_translation: tsunami shallow water approach کرتے وقت کیا ہوتا ہے؟
A: Speed decreases, wavelength shortens, and amplitude increases / speed decrease، wavelength shorten اور amplitude increase ہوتی ہے
B: Speed and wavelength increase while amplitude decreases / speed اور wavelength increase جبکہ amplitude decrease ہوتی ہے
C: Frequency and amplitude both become zero / frequency اور amplitude دونوں zero ہو جاتے ہیں
D: It changes into an electromagnetic wave / یہ electromagnetic wave بن جاتی ہے
correct_answer: A | Speed decreases, wavelength shortens, and amplitude increases / speed decrease، wavelength shorten اور amplitude increase ہوتی ہے

question: Why may a tsunami be unnoticed in deep ocean?
urdu_translation: deep ocean میں tsunami unnoticed کیوں ہو سکتی ہے؟
A: Its height is small despite very high speed and long wavelength / very high speed اور long wavelength کے باوجود اس کی height small ہوتی ہے
B: It has no energy / اس میں energy نہیں ہوتی
C: It cannot travel through water / یہ water سے travel نہیں کر سکتی
D: It moves slower than ordinary waves / یہ ordinary waves سے slower move کرتی ہے
correct_answer: A | Its height is small despite very high speed and long wavelength / very high speed اور long wavelength کے باوجود اس کی height small ہوتی ہے

question: A sound wave has f = 250 Hz and v = 340 m/s. What is its wavelength?
urdu_translation: درج ذیل sound wave کی wavelength معلوم کریں: f = 250 Hz, v = 340 m/s

question: A wave has λ = 0.5 m and f = 200 Hz. What is its speed?
urdu_translation: درج ذیل wave کی speed معلوم کریں: λ = 0.5 m, f = 200 Hz

question: A wave has time period 0.02 s. What is its frequency?
urdu_translation: درج ذیل wave کی frequency معلوم کریں: T = 0.02 s
B: 20 Hz
correct_answer: C | 50 Hz

question: Which property explains both echoes and mirror images?
urdu_translation: echoes اور mirror images دونوں کو کون سی wave property explain کرتی ہے؟
A: Refraction / refraction
B: Reflection / reflection
correct_answer: B | Reflection / reflection

question: Which wave characteristic indicates how much energy a wave carries?
urdu_translation: کون سی wave characteristic wave کے carried energy کی مقدار indicate کرتی ہے؟
A: Frequency only / صرف frequency
B: Time period only / صرف time period
C: Wavefront direction only / صرف wavefront direction
correct_answer: D | Amplitude / amplitude
